stem: The time taken in minutes for a certain daily train journey has a normal distribution with standard deviation 5.8 . For a random sample of 20 days the journey times were noted and the mean journey time was found to be 81.5 minutes.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate a 98% confidence interval for the population mean journey time.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
A student was asked for the meaning of this confidence interval. The student replied as follows.

‘The times for 98% of these journeys are likely to be within the confidence interval.’
parts.text: Explain briefly whether this statement is true or not.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: Two independent 98% confidence intervals are found.
parts.text: Given that at least one of these intervals contains the population mean, find the probability that both intervals contain the population mean.
